info.description: Complete Postman coverage for every NestJS controller endpoint. Run folders in order for the integrated workflow. Login stores the bearer token; Postman stores the HttpOnly refresh cookie automatically. Create requests capture IDs into collection variables. Mutating requests require an ADMIN bootstrap account for full coverage.

item.name: List Floors and Choose Test Numbers

exec: const used = new Set(pm.response.json().map((floor) => floor.number)); const free = []; for (let n = 300; n >= -20 && free.length < 2; n -= 1) if (!used.has(n)) free.push(n); pm.expect(free.length, 'two unused floor numbers').to.equal(2); pm.collectionVariables.set('floorNumber', free[0]); pm.collectionVariables.set('deletableFloorNumber', free[1]);
